title: Jewellers Block and Specie Insurance: Protecting the World's Most Precious Assets
summary: Jewellers Block insurance is an all-risks commercial policy specifically designed for businesses in the jewellery, precious metals, and gemstone trade. Unlike standard property insurance (which only covers premises) or marine cargo (which only covers transit), Jewellers Block covers stock in trade wherever it is located: on premises (showroom, vault, workshop), in transit, at trade exhibitions and fairs, with sales representatives, with third parties (repair, setters, polishers), and in private residence vaults (common in Southeast Asia). It is strictly a commercial trade product, NOT retail consumer insurance. Specie is the broader insurance class covering high-value portable property including bullion, cash in transit, and precious stones.
key_facts: Commercial trade coverage: covers businesses (manufacturers, wholesalers, retailers, diamond merchants), not individual retail consumers.
Comprehensive block coverage: showroom, vault, transit, trade fairs/exhibitions, and third-party custody for repair/polishing.
Private residence coverage: specially underwritten for family-owned jewellers in SE Asia where inventory is stored in home vaults overnight.
Specie category: encompasses physical bullion, precious metals, and high-value negotiable assets.
Key underwriting criteria: graded physical vaults/safes, 24/7 alarm & dual-path monitoring, transit security protocols, strict inventory records.
Standard exclusion: unattended vehicle exclusion (theft from vehicles left without qualified security personnel is universally excluded).
